name: Retained experiment data 41044732432
body: Original Actions artifacts for the eBPF model-discovery experiments, including requested failed or superseded attempts. The provenance archive includes artifact indexes, run and job metadata, check annotations, log availability, and SHA-256 checksums. Oversized assets are uploaded as lossless numbered parts; their manifests in provenance.tar.gz record the original hash, part hashes, and exact reassembly command. A failed run may have no artifact or log blob; absence is recorded explicitly. Publication does not certify any empirical success; interpretation follows the repository's run history and generated report. Data are from synthetic test applications.
